tools.name: check_loan_eligibility
tools.description: Estimate Fibe Personal Loan eligibility for a salaried Indian resident given monthly income and monthly expenses. Returns indicative eligible loan amount, tenure, indicative EMI, interest rate, processing fee, foreclosure charges, and an apply URL. This is a non-binding pre-check; the binding offer is generated by Fibe after KYC and underwriting on the Fibe portal/app.

monthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly income in INR. Range: 20000 – 1000000.

monthlyExpense.description: Total monthly expenses in INR. Range: 0 – 1000000.

tools.name: get_eligibility_criteria
tools.description: Return the published eligibility criteria, fees, indicative interest rate range, tenure options, document requirements, and apply URL for a Fibe Personal Loan. Takes no input.

tools.name: validate_customer_eligibility
tools.description: Pre-check whether the supplied date of birth, monthly salary, and employment type satisfy Fibe Personal Loan basic eligibility. Returns a boolean eligible flag and a user-facing message.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format.
